title: Josh's Zombies
description: This mod adds new zombies to minecraft, currently only cave zombies. This is a vanilla friendly mod so mostly cosmetic changes or variances that dont effect greater gameplay.
body:
# JOSH'S ZOMBIES
## Adds vanilla friendly Cave Zombies

![Cave Zombie](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9d98f9676f9bea2df0e3979deaf337c04a990b37_0.webp)

Adds Cave Zombies. This mod is vanilla friendly adds 9 new zombie textures and model variants that all the new zombies can spawn with. The zombies have a small chance to drop iron copper or gold nuggets when killed. The dynamite zombie can drop gunpowder or has a 50% chance to cause a nondestructive explosion when killed.

I plan to add more zombie types in the future.

Feel free to use this mod however you want.
